Why North Scottsdale is its own job

Bigger houses do not need a different checklist. They need honest hours.

North Scottsdale runs large: four and five thousand square feet is ordinary, stone and glass are everywhere, and the hard surfaces that make these houses beautiful are the ones that show every mark. The mistake companies make here is quoting a flat price against a house they have not walked, then sending two people for three hours and calling it done. We bill an hourly rate for a two-person crew precisely so a big house gets the hours a big house takes, and you can see the arithmetic before you agree to it.

Guard-gated is not a problem. Tell us the community and the gate procedure when you book, and it goes on the crew's standing notes rather than being re-explained every visit.
